<title level="1" right="Class Feature 11">[Perpetual Potency](/Classes.aspx?ID=1)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 66

**Class** Alchemist
</column>

---

Your perpetual infusions improve, allowing you to use Quick Alchemy to create more powerful items with no cost. The items you can select depend on your research field and must be in your formula book.

See specific [research fields](ResearchFields.aspx) for more information.
